label: Bella Sister — tablier crème
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one high-resolution full-body static character sprite for Resident Evil Combat, a 2D fighting game.
The supplied images are documentary references from ORIGINAL Resident Evil 4 (2005), not the remake. Image 1 is a native in-game bottlecap display of both sisters; image 2 is the original costume/head detail. Generate only the one sister specified below. Do not combine the women. Remove the screenshot base, labels and UI. No human victim, violence in progress, added injury detail or effects.
Create a new combat-ready pose facing SCREEN LEFT, three-quarter side view, both feet grounded beneath her long skirt. Exactly ONE red original-game chainsaw gripped naturally by two hands, right hand at the rear grip and left hand around the forward top handle, blade pointing diagonally left and down clear of her body. Full blade, both handles, hands, bandaged head, entire clothing hem and shoes all inside the canvas. Do not make hands touch chain teeth. Maintain ordinary adult human proportions and five-finger hands where visible.
Detailed realistic painted game sprite with crisp silhouette and original muted costume colors, not vector art, not chibi, no anime redesign. Genuinely transparent RGBA background with a fully solid opaque character, no fog, no colored haze, no ground shadow. Generous empty transparent margin of at least 8 percent on ALL sides. No scenery, border, text, logo, watermark, second woman, turnaround or costume sheet. A single generated static candidate for review.

SUBJECT LOCK: ONLY the sister in FRONT in image 1, also on the RIGHT in image 2. She wears a faded BLUE-GRAY buttoned blouse with a pale collar and rolled or gathered sleeves, a worn CREAM full apron tied at the waist over a long dark muted purplish/brown skirt, and simple worn dark brown shoes. Her adult head is wrapped with off-white dirty cloth bandages leaving the mouth and sparse teeth visible exactly as in the original-game close-up. Keep the blouse blue-gray: cream belongs to the APRON ONLY. Do not use the other sister's ochre blouse or green skirt. Preserve natural clothing wear without adding graphic gore. Standing restrained alert posture, not crouched on a base.
